lead.hed: Defense News: Ukraine asks the EU to fund its first PAC-3 Patriot buy
lead.insight: Defense News, Saturday: Kyiv asked to tap a €90 billion EU support loan for PAC-3 interceptors for Patriot batteries — the first formal request to use that loan for the U.S.-made missiles. Because PAC-3s are built in the United States, the purchase needs an exemption from the loan’s non-EU content cap. Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said the review was moving and that EU representatives were due to decide Monday.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Army photo by Maj. Nicholas Chopp · DVIDS 7275187 · Public domain · A PAC-2 Patriot interceptor launches during a live-fire exercise in Palau, June 15, 2022.

political.hed: USNI: Abraham Lincoln makes a WestPac port call in Thailand
political.insight: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse, Friday: USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) pulled into Laem Chabang, Thailand, on Wednesday — the carrier’s first full port stop since the start of the current cruise. The weekly pulse is a ship-movement summary, not a battle report.

political.hed: USNI: U.S. and Iran trade strikes along the Strait of Hormuz
political.insight: USNI News, Friday: the United States resumed attacking Iranian targets along the Strait of Hormuz this week. Central Command posted video on X saying it hit Iranian targets, including two unidentified ships. The item is a CENTCOM release plus Iranian counter-messaging.

political.hed: Defense News: Air Force speeds a cheaper Reaper successor after Iran losses
political.insight: Defense News, Friday: the Air Force is accelerating a cheaper, more expendable follow-on to the MQ-9A Reaper after combat losses. Officials did not announce a new fielding date. The Massed Modular Aircraft competition is the named path.

tech.hed: Heritage: China is working the U.S. fight over AI data centers
tech.insight: Heritage Foundation, Thursday: the essay says CCP-linked actors have amplified U.S. local fights over AI data centers, treating power prices and siting fights as a way to slow American compute. It is commentary, not a new statute.

tech.hed: NVIDIA at IFA: local agents, PAIR routing, RTX Spark in October
tech.insight: NVIDIA vendor post from IFA: local agents get simpler setup on RTX hardware, RTX Spark Windows PCs arrive in October, and NVIDIA PAIR can route inference across idle PCs.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: bad publicity can still find the quiet builders
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Friday: “The Benefits of Bad Publicity” says a public fight can surface neighbors who are already doing the work — educators and parents building classical schools instead of performing online.

culture.hed: Heritage: State says it has revoked more than 175,000 visas
culture.insight: Heritage Foundation, Thursday: the State Department announced it had revoked more than 175,000 visas since President Trump took office, citing continuous vetting against fraud and crime. The piece is commentary on that announcement.
